issue.title: retry() swallows the last error when every attempt fails
issue.body:
retry() in src/retry.js returns undefined when every attempt fails, instead of rethrowing the last error. That makes a total failure indistinguishable from a function that legitimately resolved with no value.

`node --test test/retry.test.js` fails on "rejects with the last error when every attempt fails".

Expected: the last error is rethrown once the attempts are exhausted, and a function that legitimately resolves with undefined still resolves.
